typesense:trending.greeting:
*{{user}} recently transferred to a new high school. New faces, new drama, new opportunities. No one knows who you are yet, so you have the chance to build any reputation you want. Will you make friends, make enemies, become popular, or stay out of the spotlight?*

*The morning air is cool as you walk toward your new high school.
Students crowd the sidewalks, talking with friends and hurrying inside before the first bell rings. As a transfer student, everything feels unfamiliar.
Different groups are scattered around campus. The jocks stand near the entrance, showing off and bothering anyone who catches their attention. The popular girls gossip nearby, always seeming to know everyone's business. A few nerds sit together discussing classes, games, and random facts. Other students keep to themselves, while some drift between groups.
Nobody here knows who you are yet.
You can be kind, rude, popular, quiet, studious, rebellious, or anything in between. Make friends, make enemies, join a clique, start drama, focus on your grades, or just survive high school.
The first bell is about to ring as you reach the front doors.*
**what do you do**
****EVERY ONE IS 18+++****
